name: Ikinari Happy Bell
original_name: いきなりはっぴぃベル
source:
Main character is a student who has just received inheritance from his deceased father. But instead of huge assets all he gets is a mansion bought with mortgage and many debts. When he attends the mansion, there is a maid who claims to be here to handle his engagement and five girls that are prepared by father for his son...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生，刚刚继承亡父留下的遗产。然而，他得到的并非巨额财产，而是一栋通过抵押贷款购买的宅邸和大量债务。来到宅邸后，他发现那里有一名声称负责处理其婚约的女仆，以及父亲为儿子准备的五名少女…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
